_comment: circuit-agent configuration — edit these values before starting

api._note: Public CIRCUIT API. Self-hosters: change to http://localhost:18960 and set CIRCUIT_INTERNAL_KEY in .env to bypass payment.

strategy._phase1_note: Phase 1 features (all opt-in, default disabled): Token Safety blocks risky trades using circuit-node verdict; Rebalancer detects concentration>25% or age>4h; Yield Finder discovers APY opportunities. Enable in config or dashboard.
strategy._tuning_note_2026_07_08: maxRunUpFromLowPct (default null = collect-only, same rollout as S2): reject entries where price already ran this % off its 20-min low (feed field runUpFromLowPct, now in entryConditions). Backtested: reject >5% = win +3-4pts, avg gross +1-2%, keeps ~2/3 of trades. Cost telemetry: every closed trade now books feesSol (Jito tip + network fee, both legs) and netPnlSol/netPnlPct; pnlSol stays swap-level gross for record continuity — at 0.005 SOL size the booked costs run ~13-40% of the position and were previously invisible to reflect/plan-grading/reputation.
strategy._tuning_note_2026_06_24: Anti-pump (#1): maxEntry6hGainPct/maxEntry24hGainPct gate out parabolic tokens (a dip on a +318%/6h pump is the blow-off top, not a dip — it was the #1 loss driver). hotTrend6hPct: above this 6h gain, trend-alignment reward drops 15->6 so the score stops steering into extended pumps. Exit realign (#3): lockProfitTriggerPct/lockProfitFraction ratchet the trailing-stop floor up to lockProfitFraction*peak once peak>=trigger, so a winner exits GREEN instead of round-tripping to breakeven (a +4.5% peak was realizing -0.1%). Only raises the floor; never loosens the stop.
strategy._strategy_note: buyCooldownMinutes: skip re-entry on the same mint for this many minutes after closing a position. paperTrading: true enables paper mode — no real swaps, free data sources only. paperSolBalance: starting virtual SOL for paper mode. deadMoneyMinutes/deadMoneyRangePct/deadMoneyMinHoldMinutes: exit early if pnl stays within ±deadMoneyRangePct for deadMoneyMinutes (after holding at least deadMoneyMinHoldMinutes). minHoldBeforeTpMinutes/minHoldBeforeSlMinutes: suppress TP/SL exits within this many minutes after entry to prevent phantom exits from price-feed lag.
strategy._tuning_note_2026_06_18: S1 requireEntryConfirm: re-read live price right before buy, abort if it faded > entryConfirmMaxFadePct below the scan price (kills stale-bounce fills, the 73%-never-green root cause). S3 bounceScoreMode 'modest' stops rewarding big (exhausted) 5m bounces; 'magnitude' = legacy curve. S2 requireFreshBounce (default false): gate on the 1m turn still advancing — left OFF to collect bounceFresh vs outcomes first (see entryConditions in trade_history). S5 hardStopMultiple: below stopLossPct*this, exit immediately without the Jupiter-defer that let fast dumps gap to -10%.
strategy._holderNote: holderExodusExit: off|alert|exit — re-checks entry-time top-5 holders of open positions; on a >= holderExitDropPct balance drop, alert (default) or force a 'whale-exit'.
strategy._dcaNote: Phase 2 DCA Auto-Executor: dcaEnabled activates scheduled dollar-cost-averaging buys. dcaSchedules: array of {id, mint, amountSol, intervalMs, name}. Example: {id: 'weekly-circ', mint: '8fQ2GG...', amountSol: 0.1, intervalMs: 604800000, name: 'Weekly CIRC'}. Each schedule buys every intervalMs if conditions met (balance OK, not paused, rug status OK). Executions logged to data/dca_executions.json.
strategy._ecosystemNote: Phase 2 Ecosystem Intel Feed: monitors Solana network health. ecosystemEnabled activates monitoring. Checks TPS, MEV %, validator count every heartbeat. Alerts via Telegram when thresholds breached. Health data logged to data/ecosystem_health.json, alerts to data/ecosystem_alerts.json.

circuit._note: Agent will warn when CIRCUIT balance drops below this (for API payment top-up)

swap._note: dynamicTip sizes the Jito tip to the trade: clamp(solSide*tipPct, tipMin, tipMax) lamports. The old flat 0.001 SOL tip was ~20% of a 0.005 SOL entry — fees ran 2.4x gross P&L across the swarm. Set dynamicTip=false to restore the fixed tip.

copilot._note: Solana copilot: research_token/inspect_wallet tools + price/wallet watches. Price watches are one-shot USD alerts checked every watchIntervalMs on the free price feed; wallet watches fire on SOL moves >= walletDeltaSol or token-account changes, max 5 (RPC cost). follow_wallet copy-signals a wallet on new-token entries; followShadowBuy=true additionally lets it shadow-buy (double-gated, same rug/blacklist/survival checks as normal trades).
copilot._watches_note: watchesEnabled: master switch for all watch types (price/wallet/follow). holderExodusEnabled: alerts when major holders exit a position you're holding.

risk._note: maxTop5HolderPct: skip tokens where the top-5 wallets control more than this fraction of total supply. Backtested at +17pp win rate improvement — tokens above 30% showed 80% stop-loss rate in swarm history.
risk._note2: dailyLossLimitSol: OPT-IN daily kill-switch (0 = disabled). When the day's realized NET P&L (fees included) reaches -limit, no new buys until UTC midnight; exits keep running.

x402Inference._note: When enabled, tool-FREE calls (task-review, reflect) run on the Circuit 32B engine via REAL x402 CIRC payment instead of OpenRouter. Tool-USING calls (processor/agent-loop) stay on OpenRouter — the engine has no function-calling. gatewayUrl: http://localhost:18970/v1 on the VPS, or https://inference.circuitllm.xyz/v1 remote. Costs CIRC per call + ~11 tok/s, so use only for non-time-critical reasoning.

llm._note: provider: 'openrouter' (cloud) or 'ollama' (local). baseUrl overrides provider default. openrouterKey or OPENROUTER_API_KEY env var.

survival._note: Warn when SOL < minSolWarning. Pause new buys when SOL < minSolPause. circuitReinvestPct: fraction of each profit used to buy CIRCUIT (0.40 = 40%). Raised from 0.25 — at 27% win rate and 0.005 SOL entries, 25% reinvest was insufficient to rebuild CIRCUIT balance faster than API calls drained it.

reflect._note: Self-improvement loop interval (default 4h). autoApply: true = auto-apply suggested config changes within safe bounds. Enabled — the reflect loop's suggestions (minLiquidity 75k→80k, minScanScore adjustments) were correct but never applied because this was false.

telegram._note: Set token here OR in TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN env var. heartbeatChatId = your Telegram user ID to receive heartbeat messages.

heartbeat._note: intervalMs: proactive check-in cadence (default 5 min, 0 to disable). contextRefreshMs: how often to refresh cached SOL price + Fear & Greed index (default 30 min).

swarm._note: autoPublish: emit buy/sell signals automatically on trade execution. minReputationToFollow: only factor signals from agents above this reputation score (0-100). consensusBoostFactor: scale entry size when swarm consensus agrees (e.g. 1.2 = 20% larger). consensusBoostMinScore: independent score must reach this before the boost applies (null = minScanScore+10). blacklistVerifyTopN: re-verify swarm blacklist entries against RugCheck for the top N scored candidates before filtering — prevents hallucinated blacklist entries from silently dropping good trades. S6 diversityWindow: each agent deterministically picks from the top-N candidates within diversityScoreBand points of the best (and above minScanScore), seeded by agentId, so the swarm spreads across tokens instead of all piling into scored[0] (≤1 disables). diversityScoreBand: score points below the top still eligible for diversity selection.

agentLoop._note: How often the agent reasons about and updates its session strategy (default 90 min). The LLM tunes patternFilter/minScore for the next window. defaultMode pins the trading mode (operator preference) — the LLM may still narrow patternFilter/minScore but cannot switch out of this mode; remove this key to hand mode control back to the LLM. Modes: active (auto-buy best scorer), selective (LLM gate per candidate), watchOnly (scan only, no buys).

dashboard._note: Local web dashboard at http://localhost:18800 (loopback only — use SSH tunnel for remote access). apiKey: require x-api-key header on all API routes. allowCors: explicit origin to allow (e.g. 'http://localhost:3000') — leave empty to disable CORS entirely.

memory._note: Memory system. Default-safe: enabled=false makes every path fall back to current behavior. Set enabled=true to activate the per-flag defaults below. planGrading/proceduralHistory/tradeRecall are cheap read-back wins on the agent own decisions; episodeRecall/chatExtraction/consolidation stay off until operator chat volume justifies them.

search._note: Web search configuration. enabled: master switch (default true). cacheTtlMs: how long to cache results in milliseconds (default 1 hour = 3600000). rateLimit: max searches per session (default 10). Cache file: data/web_search_cache.json
